storage.datetime_storage: UTC timestamp text; UI converts when a local display is needed
storage.date_only_storage: YYYY-MM-DD interpreted as Asia/Seoul calendar date

execution_logs.purpose: 계획값을 덮어쓰지 않는 실제 실행 기록
execution_logs.actual_minutes_rule: server computes rounded minute difference between ended_at and started_at; task estimated_minutes is never overwritten

completion_events.purpose: 활성 완료 이벤트 중복 방지와 완료 취소 이력
completion_events.active_unique_rule: task_id is unique only while reverted_at IS NULL
completion_events.duplicate_rule: partial unique index allows at most one active (reverted_at IS NULL) completion event per task; repeated complete requests remain one active record

reflections.unique_rule: 앱은 plan_id별 최신 reflection 한 건을 조회하고 기존 행이 있으면 update, 없으면 insert

carryovers.write_rule: SEE에서 저장한 next_improvement를 다음 PLAN의 carryover_text/source_reflection_id로 넘기고 새 계획 저장 시 source/target 관계를 기록

task_sort_rules.due: due_date ASC, priority high->medium->low, created_at ASC, id ASC
task_sort_rules.priority: priority high->medium->low, due_date ASC, id ASC
task_sort_rules.title: Korean locale title ASC, id ASC

summary_rules.overdue_count: active tasks where status != completed and due_date is before today in Asia/Seoul
summary_rules.blocked_count: distinct active tasks having at least one execution_log with non-empty blocker_reason
summary_rules.estimated_minutes: sum of estimated_minutes for active tasks; 0 when none
summary_rules.actual_minutes: sum of actual_minutes for execution_logs attached to active tasks; 0 when none
summary_rules.today_rule: overdue comparison uses current calendar date in Asia/Seoul
summary_rules.drilldown_rule: plan/completed/overdue/blocked/expected/actual/difference metric buttons reveal the source tasks or execution logs

export_contract.history_rule: soft-deleted tasks and reverted completion events are included so the exported file preserves the full stored history
